description: This file defines differentiation-related functions for the PyTorch autograd system, including Jacobian, Hessian, VJP, JVP, VHP, and HVH computations, along with utility functions to handle Tensor inputs and their transformations. The functions facilitate advanced automatic differentiation techniques such as forward and reverse mode AD with support for batched computations.

methods.name: _as_tuple_nocheck(x)
methods.description: Converts input to a tuple if it isn't one already, used internally.

methods.name: _as_tuple(inp, arg_name=None, fn_name=None)
methods.description: Ensures that the input is a tuple of Tensors, raising errors if elements are not Tensors.

methods.name: _tuple_postprocess(res, to_unpack)
methods.description: Unpacks nested tuples of Tensors to match the original input structure.

methods.name: _grad_preprocess(inputs, create_graph, need_graph)
methods.description: Prepares input tensors for differentiation, ensuring they require gradients as needed.

methods.name: _grad_postprocess(inputs, create_graph)
methods.description: Removes gradient history from tensors if create_graph is False.

methods.name: _validate_v(v, other, is_other_tuple)
methods.description: Validates that vector inputs match expected shape and size.

methods.name: _check_requires_grad(inputs, input_type, strict)
methods.description: Checks whether tensors require gradients, raising errors if not in strict mode.

methods.name: _autograd_grad( outputs, inputs, grad_outputs=None, create_graph=False, retain_graph=None, is_grads_batched=False, )
methods.description: Wrapper around torch.autograd.grad that accepts None as output and handles batched gradients.

methods.name: _fill_in_zeros(grads, refs, strict, create_graph, stage)
methods.description: Replaces None gradients with zeros or raises errors depending on strict mode.

methods.name: vjp(grad_output)
methods.description: Computes vector-Jacobian product for a function at given inputs.

methods.name: jvp(tangents)
methods.description: Computes Jacobian-vector product for a function at given inputs.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,...] _construct_standard_basis_for( tensors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], tensor_numels: tuple[int, ...] )
methods.description: Constructs standard basis vectors for batched Jacobian computations.

methods.name: jacobian( func, inputs, create_graph=False, strict=False, vectorize=False, strategy="reverse-mode", )
methods.description: Calculates the Jacobian matrix of a function at specified inputs, supports vectorized mode.

methods.name: hessian( func, inputs, create_graph=False, strict=False, vectorize=False, outer_jacobian_strategy="reverse-mode", )
methods.description: Computes the Hessian matrix of a scalar function at given inputs, with options for vectorization.

methods.name: vhp(func, inputs, v=None, create_graph=False, strict=False)
methods.description: Calculates vector-Hessian product, useful for second-order derivative computations.

methods.name: hvp(func, inputs, v=None, create_graph=False, strict=False)
methods.description: Calculates Hessian-vector product, similar to vhp, with different performance characteristics.
